newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 29.63 points at 7,037.83, which was within flirting distance of its record close of 7,067.46 set one week ago.

* Nobel Peace Prize co-winner Jose Ramos-Horta on Tuesday called on President Bill Clinton to step up the pressure on Indonesia and endorse a referendum in East Timor to determine the territory's future.
* On Tuesday, the Composite Index rose 3.94 points, or 0.56 percent, to close at 701.31 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,387.5/88.5 at 0200 GMT, compared with Tuesday's closing of 2,388.0/88.5.
* Indosat after J.P. Morgan raised its rating to "buy" from "long-term buy".
* Indofood on news reports that analysts were mixed on implications from its proposed rights issue.
* Budi Acid Jaya on reports that its 1996 profits would be higher than analysts' forecasts.
* Indorama after announcing its 1996 results and forecast of higher profits in 1997.
* Conglomerate Bimantara Citra on a news report that it would start operating a car assembly plant with South Korea's Hyundai Motor Company next year in West Java.

* Car maker Astra International on a media report last Friday that the company and its Japanese principal had discussed Indonesia's national car policy, and increasing local content in Astra-produced vehicles.
* Holding company Bakrie & Brothers on reports that the group was planning to set up a consortium with several local businessmen to acquire privately-owned Bank Pacific.

* Retailer Multipolar and Hero Supermarket on speculation the Lippo Group had targeted Hero for a takeover or possible link-up, despite company denials. Also on recent reports that the founder of retailer Matahari, Hari Darmawan, was planning to raise his stake in Multipolar, which recently acquired a controlling 50.1 percent interest in Matahari.
